mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE id = #{userId} AND current_challenge_id = #{challengeId}
SELECT name FROM CHALLENGE WHERE id = #{challengeId}

SELECT f.*, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url FROM FEED f JOIN USERS u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FEED (user_id, challenge_id, media_url, thumbnail_url, media_type, status, spending_type, saving_amount, category, custom_category, caption) VALUES (#{userId}, #{challengeId}, #{mediaUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{mediaType}, 'ACTIVE', #{spendingType}, #{savingAmount}, #{category}, #{customCategory}, #{caption})

INSERT INTO FEED_ANALYSIS (feed_id, recommended_spending_type, recommended_category, estimated_saving_amount, analysis_summary, confidence_score) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{spendingType}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{summary}, #{confidence})
INSERT INTO MESSAGE (challenge_id, user_id, message_type, reference_feed_id, content) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, 'FEED_SHARE', #{feedId}, '새 절약 피드를 공유했어요.')
INSERT INTO MESSAGE (challenge_id, user_id, message_type, reference_feed_id, content) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{feedId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, m.message_type, m.reference_feed_id, m.content, m.created_at, f.media_url, f.thumbnail_url, f.media_type FROM MESSAGE m JOIN USERS u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN FEED f ON f.id = m.reference_feed_id WHERE m.challenge_id = #{challengeId} ORDER BY m.created_at
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saving_amount), 0) FROM FEED WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
